boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Middlebury College
boards.description: Ten distinct, under-21-safe food and convenience destinations with currently published evening availability in or near Middlebury.

cards.title: Midd Express
cards.subtitle: McCullough Student Center, Middlebury College
cards.notes: Use the convenience stop for a late pickup; check the published seasonal schedule first, since the listed midnight hours end after August 13.
cards.short_summary: Campus convenience store with published summer hours through midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Middlebury Dining lists Midd Express summer hours of 8:00 AM–midnight daily through August 13, 2026.
cards.access_notes: Published summer schedule: 8:00 AM–midnight daily through 2026-08-13; hours after that date are not listed on this page.

cards.title: The Grille
cards.subtitle: McCullough Student Center, Middlebury College
cards.notes: Plan an evening food stop in McCullough and confirm the next operating period before heading over; the current summer schedule ends today.
cards.short_summary: Campus grill with a published summer service window to midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Middlebury Dining lists The Grille's summer hours as Tuesday–Saturday, 7:00 PM–midnight, through August 13, 2026.
cards.access_notes: Published summer schedule: Tuesday–Saturday, 7:00 PM–midnight through 2026-08-13; confirm subsequent hours directly.

cards.title: Ross Dining Hall
cards.subtitle: Middlebury College campus
cards.notes: For an on-campus evening meal, arrive before the posted dinner close and use the dining program’s current hours page to confirm service.
cards.short_summary: Dining hall whose regular dinner period runs to 8:30 PM.
cards.evidence_claim: Middlebury Dining publishes Ross Dining Hall dinner until 8:30 PM every day under its normal hours.
cards.access_notes: Normal published dinner closes at 8:30 PM daily; dining schedules can change during College breaks.

cards.title: Atwater Dining Hall
cards.subtitle: Middlebury College campus
cards.notes: Build this into a weekday evening plan and arrive before dinner ends; consult Dining Services for any break-period or special-service changes.
cards.short_summary: Weekday dining hall with dinner scheduled through 8:30 PM.
cards.evidence_claim: Middlebury Dining publishes Atwater Dining Hall dinner Monday–Friday from 5:00 PM to 8:30 PM.
cards.access_notes: Normal published weekday dinner is 5:00–8:30 PM; verify service when the College is on break.

cards.title: Proctor Dining Hall
cards.subtitle: Middlebury College campus
cards.notes: Use the seven-day dinner window for an early-evening campus meal, keeping the published 8:00 PM close in mind when planning your trip.
cards.short_summary: Seven-day dining hall with dinner listed until 8:00 PM.
cards.evidence_claim: Middlebury Dining publishes Proctor Dining Hall dinner from 4:30 PM to 8:00 PM seven days a week.
cards.access_notes: Normal published dinner closes at 8:00 PM daily; check the dining calendar for exceptions.

cards.title: Green Peppers Restaurant
cards.subtitle: 10 Washington Street, Shaw’s Plaza, Middlebury
cards.notes: For a Friday or Saturday evening pickup, place an order before the posted 9:00 PM closing time and confirm the Tuesday closure.
cards.short_summary: Pizza and takeout restaurant open latest on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Green Peppers lists Friday and Saturday hours of 10:00 AM–9:00 PM and identifies its Middlebury Shaw’s Plaza address.
cards.access_notes: Published hours: Friday–Saturday 10:00 AM–9:00 PM; Sunday–Thursday 10:00 AM–8:00 PM; closed Tuesday.

cards.title: American Flatbread Middlebury Hearth
cards.subtitle: 137 Maple Street, Middlebury
cards.notes: Reserve or arrange pickup for a downtown evening meal; the official location page lists service through 9:00 PM on its open nights.
cards.short_summary: Wood-fired flatbread restaurant in the Marble Works district with 9 PM closes.
cards.evidence_claim: American Flatbread lists Middlebury Hearth at 137 Maple Street and publishes dinner hours ending at 9:00 PM Tuesday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Published close is 9:00 PM Tuesday–Saturday; closed Sunday and Monday. Wednesday–Saturday also have midday service.

cards.title: The Mad Taco
cards.subtitle: 3 Mill Street, Middlebury
cards.notes: Choose a dinner pickup or sit-down stop on Mill Street before the daily 8:00 PM close, allowing time for ordering and travel.
cards.short_summary: Middlebury taco restaurant with daily service until 8 PM.
cards.evidence_claim: The Mad Taco’s Middlebury page lists its 3 Mill Street location as open daily from noon until 8:00 PM.
cards.access_notes: Officially listed as open daily, noon–8:00 PM.

cards.title: Rosie’s Restaurant
cards.subtitle: 886 Route 7 South, Middlebury
cards.notes: Plan a Route 7 evening meal before the published 8:00 PM close; the restaurant’s own contact page gives both the address and seven-day hours.
cards.short_summary: Family-style Middlebury restaurant open daily through 8 PM.
cards.evidence_claim: Rosie’s Restaurant lists its address as 886 Route 7 South, Middlebury, and its hours as 7:00 AM–8:00 PM seven days a week.
cards.access_notes: Officially listed as open every day, 7:00 AM–8:00 PM.

cards.title: Nino’s Pizza
cards.subtitle: 21 MacIntyre Lane, Middlebury
cards.notes: Call ahead for a pickup window and rely on the current location page rather than older posts; it currently lists evening service until 8:00 PM.
cards.short_summary: Pizza takeout destination with published 8 PM closing on open days.
cards.evidence_claim: Nino’s lists its Middlebury location at 21 MacIntyre Lane, with hours Monday–Friday 11:00 AM–8:00 PM and Saturday 1:00–8:00 PM.
cards.source_title: About Nino’s Pizza in Middlebury, Vermont
cards.access_notes: Published hours: Monday–Friday 11:00 AM–8:00 PM and Saturday 1:00–8:00 PM; closed Sunday.
